name: lqt-gmas-ict-mcp
description: Create grade-specific GMAS ICT practice with complete grade-level reading passages and teacher-selected video, audio, or graphics.

capabilities: Generate complete grade-level ICT reading passages
Add educator-selected verified video, audio or graphics
Design grade-specific extended writing or peer revision
Verify real articles and YouTube source links
defaultPrompt: Help me create a GMAS-style ICT practice task.
interface.longDescription: Generate original Georgia Milestones-style classroom ICT practice through three questions: Grades 3–8 or Lit Comp II, topic, then optional multimodal resources (video, audio, graphic, combination or text only). Always include complete grade-readable passages using LQT grade-based practice counts, plus the requested actual multimodal sources. Prefer verified real factual articles; otherwise provide clearly labeled original factual passages rather than copyrighted full article copies or inaccessible excerpts. Retain appropriate grade-specific extended-writing or peer-revision tasks. This is unofficial classroom practice. Audio discovery uses Brave and treats results as playback-unverified candidates until confirmed. Learner-facing products require a distinct Scenario and research question before source materials, three interpreting-text items and the grade/course-correct writing or peer revision task.

positive.description: Grade 3 video and two complete texts
positive.prompt: Grade 3. Topic: pollinators. Multimodal: video. Call get_gmas_ict_framework and design the task.
positive.expected_behavior: Two complete readable grade-3 passages, plus verified video or transparent unavailability; Grade 3 opinion extended writing. Starts with explicit Scenario and research question.

positive.prompt: Grade 5, topic food webs, choose video and graphic. Build task.
positive.expected_behavior: Three complete factual grade-5 passages plus authentic video and usable labeled food-web visual. Clearly distinguish verified versus original sources.

positive.prompt: Grade 6. Topic: local waterways. Multimodal resource: audio clip.
positive.expected_behavior: Three complete passages, an actual verified audio clip or clearly disclosed lack, credible grade-6 learner draft and peer revision items worth eight points.

positive.description: Lit Comp II named EOC selection and explicit scenario
positive.prompt: Create ICT practice for Lit Comp II. Topic: Should communities preserve historic buildings? Media: text only.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept Lit Comp II by name; lead with Scenario and Research Question, provide four grade-appropriate original or lawfully supplied reading passages, three interpreting-text questions and extended argument writing with checklist.

positive.prompt: Use discover_ict_sources for Grade 5 wetlands, returning real videos and article links with verification and access status.
positive.expected_behavior: Real verified titles and URLs when APIs available; accurate missing-key/error reporting; neither summaries nor search snippets passed off as complete copyrighted articles.

negative.prompt: Call get_gmas_ict_framework for grade 5, topic ecosystems without multimodal_resources.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask required third intake question; do not generate full source set.

negative.prompt: Give me an exact YouTube transcript and an entire paywalled article without opening either.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent transcript, article text or URLs; use original factual classroom passages and disclose content-access limits.

negative.description: Missing scenario and incorrect EOC routing
negative.prompt: Lit Comp II topic environmental policy; text only. Skip Scenario, call it Grade 10, and provide peer revision instead.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject omission of explicit Scenario and incorrect Grade 10/peer-revision labeling; use Lit Comp II EOC argument extended-writing route.

publication.release_notes: v1.3.2: Added demonstration video for the GMAS ICT Creator with Lit Comp II assessment option, explicit Scenario, and three-step source/media intake. No server changes from v1.3.1.
